# Myrat Daniyarov - Professional Portfolio

## Introduction
Myrat Daniyarov is a Project Manager Assistant and Digital Creator based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. He specializes in e-commerce, web development, and AI tools, offering a unique blend of technical expertise and creative problem-solving.

## Key Projects
- **WeddingPlans.site**: An elegant event management platform designed to simplify wedding planning.
- **Nothing2.store**: An innovative e-commerce application focused on seamless user experience, fast load times, and secure transactions.
- **Language Learning App**: An interactive application leveraging modern frontend technologies to provide engaging educational content.
